text: Fashion Design Program is the comprehensive specialty involving garment design, accessories design, fashion, image design, marketing, management and fashion show. The course blends individual creativity and commercial realism, and you will be able to apply your skills and knowledge of the professional design process, from concept to product and attributes to succeed in a wide range of careers in the fashion industry. Learning outcomes To help you develop a good foundation of fashion knowledge and skills in both design and technical areas To grasp the basic methods of Fashion and prediction of fashion To understand the basic operation knowledge of garment enterprises and market To have ability to produce garments that reflect your personal direction as a creative fashion design graduate Core Curriculum Introduction to fashion, Fashion accessories Design, Marketing, Image Design, Brand Clothing Design, Garment construction, Professional Software，Apparel Structure Design Future Career Our graduates go into a range of fashion-related roles. Here are some recent examples: Clothing Designers Buyers and procurement officers Image designers
